answer: An adversary therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 47 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The sparrow counter is kept in mesa and onyx shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 47 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3327 identities would post 3719 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
